title: Follow-up for #1309: reject nested :has() and :has() after pseudo-elements
items: Reject nested :has() (DISALLOW_RELATIVE_SELECTOR, inherited through :is/:where/:not), as upstream stylo does.
Reject :has() after a pseudo-element (state intersects AFTER_PSEUDO).
Specific error messages instead of 'Invalid state' (NestedHas, PseudoElementInHas).
Don't serialize :nth-child(2 of ::before) as the invalid '2 of '.
